business_problem: They needed a partner — not just a platform — capable of scaling AI-powered workflows, unifying fragmented data sources and embedding intelligence securely and compliantly across global engagements.
solution_summary: The organization’s transformation hinged on finding a platform that could power their vision end to end, from ingesting massive volumes of unstructured data to enabling nontechnical users to extract insights with speed and confidence. The Databricks Data + AI Platform enabled EY-Parthenon to accelerate development, enforce data governance, embed AI and increase scalability across the DBS initiative. One of the first critical advantages was the inherent medallion architecture core to Databricks, which provided EY-Parthenon with a robust and proven methodology to manage the lifecycle of data, from raw ingestion (Bronze), to cleaned and structured data (Silver), to analytics-ready insights (Gold).
business_outcome: EY-Parthenon achieved measurable business impact on Databricks, including 30%–50% Efficiency gains, accelerating client decision-making and unlocking new opportunities; This allows teams to analyze complex Excel models (with 50+ tabs and tens of thousands of rows), extract only relevant KPIs and correlate them with broader sector insights — all within a single workflow..

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Provides access control, governance, and lineage across EY-Parthenon's shared data products and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores EY-Parthenon's curated datasets for analytics, machine learning, and operational use cases.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, interactive analysis, and governed SQL workloads for business users at EY-Parthenon.
